jobs.title: Electrical Design Automation Engineer
jobs.description_text: Please be prepared to share portfolio, Github, etc. in advance to the recruiter welcome call We are looking for an Electrical Design Automation Engineer to accelerate how Kepler designs, analyzes, and verify the electronics inside our satellites. You are an electrical engineer who understands the complete board-development lifecycle—from schematic capture and layout through bring-up, debugging, and verification. Along the way, you have likely found yourself writing scripts or building tools to eliminate repetitive work, improve consistency, and catch problems earlier. In this role you will own the Altium component library, develop automation, and then build and integrate scripted and AI-assisted tools across our electrical design and analysis workflows for years to come. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, working alongside our electrical, FPGA, RF, software, and test engineers where you will combine practical electrical engineering judgment with programming and automation to build tools that engineers can trust, maintain, and use over time.

jobs.title: FPGA Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: We’re on the hunt for a top-tier FPGA Digital Design Engineer to develop the next generation of our satellites. At Kepler, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a dedicated team of engineers building the Kepler spacecraft. You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

jobs.title: Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer (Contingent)
jobs.description_text: Position Status: Contingent Upon Program Award As a Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical authority for satellite and space-system development programs, ensuring the integrity of system design, integration, verification, and mission readiness from concept through delivery. You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Electrical Designer & Team Lead to provide technical leadership and support the development of electrical power systems (EPS) and electronics for spacecraft mechanisms. In this role, you will lead the design and development of complex spacecraft electronics, provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers, and help ensure hardware is delivered to the required standards of performance, reliability, and quality. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams, including RF, mechanical, software, FPGA and systems engineering, to develop and integrate hardware solutions for current and future satellite platforms and customer missions.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: What if your business development experience could help advance cancer research, model climate impacts, or combat human trafficking, instead of chasing incremental deals or selling pre-packaged solutions? At Kitware, you won't be selling a fixed product or following someone else's roadmap. You'll work directly with engineers and researchers to identify opportunities, shape what gets built, and turn real-world problems into funded, high-impact technical work. That might mean shaping an AI-driven medical imaging platform, a large-scale scientific data system, or a geospatial analytics capability that doesn’t exist yet. Kitware advances science and makes the world a better place through open-source software. We collaborate with top universities, national laboratories, government agencies, and commercial technology leaders to develop both cutting-edge research prototypes and production systems with outsized real-world impact. Our tools are used by millions, including CMake, a widely used tool in C++ development. We're a 100% employee-owned company (ESOP) with no outside investors and about 200 employees. Our leadership has a technical background, and there's no middle management layer between you and the problems you're solving. We're not chasing VC rounds or seeking an exit. We're building software that will matter for decades. If you're looking to move beyond traditional business development and want a role where you'll influence what gets built, which markets we pursue, and ho

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description_text: Take ownership of complex accounting work - and help us improve how we do it. At Kitware, we're looking for an experienced accounting professional who wants to do more than maintain the books. As our Senior Accountant, you'll play an important role in maintaining financial accuracy and regulatory compliance while helping us strengthen the processes and policies that support a growing R&D software company. This role offers a mix of hands-on accounting, multi-state tax compliance, technical research, and process improvement. You'll have the independence to research complex accounting and tax issues, recommend solutions, and turn evolving requirements into practical processes that work for the business. You'll also develop a broader understanding of Kitware's finance operations, giving you the opportunity to collaborate across functions and contribute beyond your primary responsibilities. What You'll Do: Perform monthly account reconciliations and support timely, accurate financial reporting. Prepare and file state and local tax filings, including sales and use tax, gross receipts tax, and other indirect taxes across multiple jurisdictions. Conduct technical accounting research to ensure compliance with evolving regulations and government requirements. Draft, review, and update accounting policies and procedures to align with GAAP and applicable government regulations. Develop a strong understanding of adjacent finance functions, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable,

jobs.title: Associate Director, Capital Markets Finance
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a motivated Associate Director, Capital Markets Finance, preferably with a background in investment banking or equity research, to help build on and execute our capital markets strategy. Reporting to the CFO, this role will support existing relationships with analysts and investors, while also serving as a trusted resource to senior leadership on how Wall Street views our strategy, pipeline, and financial performance. The successful candidate thrives at the intersection of finance, science, and storytelling, translating complex clinical and operational data into compelling investor-ready narratives that resonate with institutional investors and analysts.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company.

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Clinical Innovation and Corporate Communications
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a Manager or Senior Manager, Clinical Innovation and Corporate Communications, to help advance our clinical trial innovation strategy, develop clinically-oriented corporate communications across our pipeline, and support broader corporate strategy and commercial development projects. This highly cross-functional role will evaluate new geographies, trial models, and other approaches that could improve the speed, efficiency, and execution of clinical development across Lexeo’s portfolio. The individual will also translate complex clinical, scientific, and regulatory information into clear, compelling communications for patients, healthcare professionals, media, investors, and other external audiences. This role will sit within the Clinical organization and partner closely with Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Investor Relations, and other functions. A successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and will have the opportunity to shape high-priority initiatives across clinical development, communications, and corporate strategy.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

The role will also coordinate ongoing L&D training and support the Manager Efficacy Program.

jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position with expectations to be Onsite 5 days/week. The role partners closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep recruiting activities organized, timely, and accurate.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EH&S) Engineer
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 24-month contract position. The Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Engineer will lead the development and ongoing management of EHS programs that keep employees safe and company operations in compliance across manufacturing and test activities. This position requires broad EHS experience in a manufacturing or R&D environment and the ability to work independently with engineering, operations, and regulatory agencies. The role is based in Akron, Ohio, with periodic travel to other company locations.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Hydrogen (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA Research builds and flies next-generation airships. Our proof-of-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. The base salary range for this role is $135,000 - 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you.

jobs.title: Director, Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East
jobs.description_text: Machina is looking for a Director of Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East to establish and grow our presence with European defense primes, with the opportunity to expand into the Middle East over time. This is our first dedicated international business development role and will operate with significant autonomy. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with engineers, program leaders, manufacturing teams, and senior executives and understands how complex defense systems move from development into production. You will work closely with Machina’s leadership, defense subsidiary, business development, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.title: Manager, Program Operations
jobs.description_text: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. International Programs turns Rainmaker’s technology and customer commitments into operating programs in new markets. The team develops local operating capability and enduring community relationships while coordinating scientific, regulatory, and logistical requirements with Rainmaker’s specialist teams.

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) Fullstack
jobs.description_text: Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu prends part chaque jour à la création de produits numériques innovants qui ont pour ambition de changer le monde, quels que soient leur envergure ou leur domaine. Ce n'est pas simplement livrer d'excellents produits et services qui t'apporte de la fierté, mais aussi le chemin parcouru pour y arriver. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description_text: En tant que responsable de produit chez Mirego, tu as pour mission de maximiser la valeur des produits numériques livrés à nos clients. Au cœur de l’équipe, tu coordonnes les différentes expertises afin d’assurer l’alignement, une communication fluide et l’atteinte des objectifs. Tu accompagnes des clients issus de divers secteurs d’activité et les aides à se réinventer grâce à des produits de haute qualité, en tenant compte de leur réalité, de leurs contraintes et de leur budget. Tu es convaincu·e que les produits numériques représentent une occasion unique de répondre aux besoins des personnes utilisatrices, de simplifier leur quotidien et de contribuer à un monde meilleur.

jobs.title: Représentant(e), développement des affaires
jobs.description_text: Tu aimes ouvrir des portes, susciter l’intérêt et transformer une première discussion en une collaboration concrète? Chez Mirego, tu contribues directement à la croissance de l’équipe en bâtissant de nouvelles relations d’affaires et en faisant naître des projets numériques d’envergure, du premier contact jusqu’à la signature. Tu prends en charge l’ensemble du cycle de vente : repérer les organisations à fort potentiel, amorcer le dialogue, qualifier les occasions, démontrer la valeur de l’approche Mirego et mener les discussions jusqu’à l’entente finale. Une fois le partenariat conclu, tu passes le relais à la personne responsable de la gestion du compte, qui veillera au succès de la relation à long terme.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.description_text: As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information. Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information. Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. You will use your industry judgement to lead complex data investigations, identify gaps and drive improvements in data quality and coverage with a high degree of independence. While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Flows
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.

jobs.title: Dominican Republic Defensive Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to advance the Boston Red Sox in pursuit of World Championships through a comprehensive and collaborative player development system. Our approach involves the creation of world-class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with other departments, we establish effective frameworks for exploration, learning, and development. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. Simply put, we strive to be the standard in player and staff development. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Defensive Coach is primarily responsible for the on-field implementation, execution, and tracking of evidence-based defensive and baserunning development for academy players in the DR. The candidate will play a key role in executing daily training initiatives and translating organizational priorities into a high-quality on-field training environment. This role also includes the opportunity to impact player development through player education, participating in player meetings, player feedback and other responsibilities that support the staff and players at the academy. As part of the responsibilities, the DR Defensive Coach will collaborate with players and field staff to maximize departmental buy-in.

jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our approach involves the creation of world class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with baseball analytics, performance, and medical, we establish effective frameworks for experimentation and learning. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Academy Hitting Coach will work closely with the other hitting coaches, the Director of Hitting Development, and other essential staff to help implement and track player-specific offensive development plans. We are seeking someone who is organized, detail-oriented, curious, and data-driven, with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills. The candidate should also be comfortable in a fast-paced environment, working closely with players, coaches, and other departments to ensure player success. This position will be based out of our academy in the Dominican Republic.

jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: As an organization, we place a substantial emphasis on maximizing player value through purposeful, long-term development. POSITION OVERVIEW: The Boston Red Sox are looking for Assistant Strength and Conditioning Coaches for the upcoming 2027 season. Assistant S&C Coaches will report to Fort Myers, FL for Spring Training and then travel with an affiliate team until the end of the team’s competitive season. Assistant S&C Coaches will be notified of their affiliate assignments during Spring Training at the discretion of the organization. Coaches will assist in the implementation of the Boston Red Sox Strength and Conditioning, Baseball Sciences, Medical, and Nutrition programs. Travel: This position will be based out of Fort Myers, Florida during Minor League Spring Training, then based out of an assigned affiliate for the duration of the competitive season. Travel to all away games is required. Occasional travel may be required to other Red Sox affiliates, staff events, and educational opportunities.

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel, Government Contracts
jobs.description_text: Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission. Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. The compensation range for this role is $200,000- $240,000/yr This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description_text: Director, Autonomous Systems DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a Director of Autonomous Systems to lead the software, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), autonomy, and simulation capabilities that underpin the Cyclops interceptor and RSX target vehicle programs. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. The compensation range for this role is $220,000 - $290,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Internal Ballistician
jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.description_text: PROGRAM MANAGER DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a motivated and technically capable Program Manager to support the execution and growth of programs serving the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and other customers. As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. You will work closely with Program Management leadership, engineering, contracts, and finance teams, government program offices, and industry partners, turning plans into schedules, tracking commitments through to closure, and ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information about program status. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment and a direct path to building program management expertise. You will gain real experience with defense acquisition, from traditional contracting to newer, faster pathways such as Other Transaction (OT) agreements and rapid prototyping, along with government contracting and customer relationship management. The compensation range for this role is $109,998 - $155,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Editor, UK & Ireland
jobs.description_text: The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. Editorial UK & Ireland sits at the heart of the listener experience on Spotify. We reflect culture and drive artist discovery through playlists, storytelling formats, and tools, with a focus on new music. As our Pop Editor, you’ll bring deep cultural expertise and a data-informed approach to shape how millions of people discover music across playlists, video, and other parts of the app.

jobs.title: Growth Lead - Japan
jobs.description_text: Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets. Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

jobs.title: Head of Markets Strategy & Operations, Japan
jobs.description_text: The Markets team is responsible for managing Spotify’s regions and their performance across all business-relevant metrics. Our team consists of regional Managing Directors and Market Strategy & Operation Managers (MSO). We are looking for a strategic, analytically-driven and open-minded character to support our efforts in Japan. As Head of Market Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for strategic direction based on business analysis and insights; business planning; regional operating processes; and managing cross-functional projects by building strong relationships across the company. In this position, you will work closely with global stakeholder, local functional leadership and report to the Managing Director, Japan

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

jobs.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success. Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

This role ensures inventory integrity across the organization by performing counts, reconciling discrepancies, and collaborating with warehouse and operations teams to resolve issues and improve overall inventory process.

jobs.title: Network - Specialist Solutions Engineer
jobs.description_text: AHEAD’s Specialist Solutions Engineers are the technical experts that collaborate with our AHEAD account teams to help identify, qualify, and build solutions that support our customer’s Digital Business transformation. The AHEAD Network Specialist Solutions Engineer (SSE) will be focused on Networking technologies. A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies. Understanding that the impetus and impact of Cloud computing is real and should be incorporated into solutions is key. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement. The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Consultant - AI Security
jobs.description_text: The Principal Technical Consultant (Forward Deployed Engineer) for AI Security is a senior, customer-facing technical leader responsible for deploying, integrating, and operationalizing AI security capabilities in real-world customer and enterprise environments, with a focus on securing AI systems, LLM applications, and agentic workflows. This role works at the intersection of engineering, AI, security, data, and customer success to translate complex requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions. This individual partners closely with security leaders, AI engineers, data scientists, platform teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to implement AI security controls, secure AI development pipelines, integrate security tooling for AI systems, and accelerate time to value. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of security experience and combines deep technical expertise in AI systems, model and data security, and cloud platforms with proven experience developing technical proposals and statements of work, leading cross-team collaboration, and driving customer-facing delivery at a principal level.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Consultant, Security
jobs.description_text: The Principal Technical Consultant (PTC) Identity Focused Security Architect is a hands-on delivery leader who designs and leads identity solution implementations in client environments. You will own identity workstreams end to end, driving architecture, implementation planning, execution oversight, and stakeholder alignment, primarily across Microsoft identity (Active Directory and Entra ID), IGA, and modern authentication patterns (SSO, MFA, password less). Experience with other IAM platforms (e.g., Okta) and PAM (e.g., Delinea, CyberArk) experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Engineer II - Rack Integration
jobs.description_text: As a Product Engineer I – Rack Integration Services, you will be instrumental in designing and implementing integrated rack solutions for enterprise-grade data center hardware. You will own rack-level design from concept through installation, including rack elevations, rack-level BOMs, power and cooling analysis, and cabling design. Your responsibilities include defining installation and integration steps, creating cable maps and routing plans, building labeling standards, and producing complete rack design documentation that supports accurate builds, labor estimation, and pre-sales assessments. You will collaborate with internal teams and clients and may travel on-site to support rack delivery and installation.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory, you will work alongside AHEAD’s consultants and practice teams at the intersection of technology, AI and business - turning ambiguous business questions from consulting teams into structured, hypothesis-led research and clear, actionable recommendations. You will independently own deliverables end-to-end, act as a credible thought partner to onsite consulting and pursuit teams and help raise the quality bar by guiding junior analysts. Your work will directly shape how AHEAD’s consulting teams understand markets, position against competitors, plan for accounts, and win complex enterprise technology deals — and how sharply those insights are communicated to CXO audiences. You will scope and prioritize requests, clarify objectives, and select the right insights on clients, markets, offerings and competition to address them. You will conduct data-driven analyses and turn the results into accurate, client-ready documents, models and charts, and join team problem-solving discussions so that recommendations are actionable and strategically relevant. Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry. jobs.title: Senior Associate Technical Consultant - VCF
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Associate Technical Consultant – VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), you will be an integral member of a collaborative team focused on deploying next-generation Data Centre and hybrid cloud solutions. You will support project teams by contributing to designing, developing, and deploying VCF-based architectures, ensuring that solutions are well-documented, secure, and aligned with business objectives. You will also participate in customer demos, workshops, and meetings with a professional demeanour. This role requires a deep understanding of VMware’s SDDC stack and a commitment to excellence. “Join us and grow your expertise - we’ll provide guidance and learning support to help you earn relevant VCF certifications.”

jobs.title: Senior Client Solutions Engineer
jobs.location_raw: Milwaukee, Wisconsin · Columbus, Ohio · Chicago, Illinois · Dallas, Texas · New York, New York
jobs.description_text: Senior Client Solutions Engineer The Senior Client Solutions Engineer assists AHEAD Client Directors through formal technical presentations and technical design assistance of AHEAD’s solution and service offerings to existing and prospective clients. The Senior Client Solutions Engineer owns all technical aspects of a sales campaign and hand off to the consulting and services team; maintaining strong relationships with our clients. In this role, you are a thought leader within the Engineering organization, responsible for designing, architecting, and, at times, consulting for AHEAD clients. We expect our Senior Client Solutions Engineer to have deep knowledge across our Enterprise Cloud Framework including Cloud Management and Operations, Security, Datacenter Infrastructure and Public Cloud. Your goal as a Senior Client Solutions Engineer should be to build skills, relationships, and industry credibility across more than one of these segments to drive product and services sales. You will work in partnership with one or more Client Directors to help build a cohesive account strategy for each existing and prospective clients. As part of this strategy, you will help Client Directors identify potential technologies and vendors to partner within a given account and assist in driving this strategy throughout the sales campaign. jobs.title: Senior Client Success Manager
jobs.description_text: The Senior Client Success Manager (Sr. CSM) owns executive-level relationships and is accountable for protecting and expanding long-term client value. This role operates as a strategic partner to the client, ensuring measurable business outcomes, proactive risk mitigation, and strong financial performance of the account. The Sr. CSM leads from the front — modeling ownership, accountability, and cross-functional alignment.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Compute
jobs.description_text: The High-Performance Computing Compute Engineer is primarily responsible for the overall health and maintenance of the infrastructure that powers high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and large-scale data workloads in our managed services customer environments. Our HPC Compute Engineers are a valued member of the Managed Services Infrastructure Practice responsible for Tier 3 incident management, service request management and change management infrastructure support for all Managed Services customers. The successful candidate will own critical components of the compute environment—from Linux hosts, GPUs, HPC clusters, and physical hardware through schedulers, containers, monitoring, automation, and version maintenance. The engineer will work closely with our internal infrastructure teams, vendors, and customers to deliver reliable, secure, and efficient AI compute services.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer,Virtualization
jobs.description_text: AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team. Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - Elixir
jobs.description_text: AHEAD is looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to join the team that builds the software behind Foundry. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security. Foundry is AHEAD's engineering and integration arm, designing and deploying custom enterprise infrastructure from the data center to the edge. Signal is our in-house ERP application, built to run the operational backbone of Foundry, supporting workflows like production and work order management, inventory and materials tracking, procurement, and integration scheduling. Signal is the system of record that keeps engineering, operations, and delivery teams aligned as infrastructure moves through design, build, and deployment. You’ll join a globally distributed, progressive engineering team across the US and India that lives on the forefront of technology: one that builds real products, adopts new tools early, and never stops learning. As a Senior Developer on the team, you’ll own features from design to delivery, working primarily in Elixir, Phoenix, and Phoenix LiveView. You’ll help shape Signal’s architecture, raise the bar on code quality, and mentor other engineers as we grow the Foundry team in India. jobs.description_text: AHEAD is seeking a senior, customer-facing Technical Consultant to lead delivery of Idira Privilege Cloud (formerly CyberArk Privilege Cloud) implementations. You will own technical workstreams from discovery and design through configuration, integration, testing, and handoff. You will advise customer security, identity, and infrastructure teams, resolve complex implementation issues, and help raise the technical quality of the broader delivery team. Idira Privilege Cloud is a SaaS privileged-access solution for safeguarding credentials, automating password rotation, and monitoring privileged sessions.
